Subject: OneTrust incremental evidence snapshot + delegated uploader checklist

Hi OneTrust team —

Acme Security has requested weekly incremental evidence snapshots from our OneTrust profile and wants to use a delegated uploader account to push the artifacts (they prefer S3 presigned uploads). Can you confirm the following so we can finalize the mutual action plan?

Ask:
- Can OneTrust deliver an incremental snapshot via API (only the changed assets since last snapshot) rather than a full export?
- Presigned upload support: what TTLs are supported and can TTL be reduced (e.g., 6 hours)?
- Delegated uploader role: what exact permissions are required and what admin approval flow is needed on the OneTrust side?
- Preferred manifest format and sample headers (we usually send a CSV with path, sha256, size, timestamp).

Acme details (for provisioning):
- They will push to our S3 bucket: s3://acme-onetrust-uploads (we will provide IAM role ARN shortly).
- Point of contact: security@acmecorp.com who is CC'd here.

Attached: onetrust_upload_instructions.pdf (draft), delegated_uploader_manifest.csv (sample).

Timing: can you reply within 48 hours? We need to schedule the upload window the week of 7/7 if possible.

Thanks — please include any portal links or admin steps we should forward to Acme.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: OneTrust Support <support@onetrust.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acmecorp.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OneTrust incremental evidence snapshot + delegated uploader checklist

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the detailed note — happy to help. Short answers up front and next steps below.

1) Incremental snapshots: supported. We provide an incremental export endpoint that returns changed records since a provided timestamp. Payload includes metadata and pointers to attachments.

2) Presigned uploads: supported. Default TTL for presigned URLs is 24 hours but we can configure shorter TTLs per customer. We can set the TTL to 6 hours for Acme; note this requires their upload retry logic to handle expired URLs.

3) Delegated uploader role: we can provision a scoped "uploader" API key tied to an organization with only upload and manifest-check permissions (no delete). Admin approval: the OneTrust account admin must approve the delegated role; we can send a one-click invite link to the admin console.

4) Manifest format: CSV is fine. Recommended headers: relative_path, filename, sha256, size_bytes, modified_iso8601, mime_type, source_system_id. See attached API spec and sample manifest.

Next steps we suggest:
- Please confirm target bucket name + IAM role ARN (we will provide a temporary policy template to attach to that role).
- Confirm whether Acme wants presign via S3 (recommended) or SFTP.
- Send us the OneTrust org ID (we will map the delegated uploader to that org).

I attached the OneTrust API spec v2 and a short checklist for delegated uploader provisioning. If you'd like, we can provision a test uploader account for staging once you confirm the bucket details.

Regards,
Maya Patel
Technical Support Engineer, OneTrust
support@onetrust.com

[Attachment: onetrust_api_spec_v2.pdf]
